leia (partner-ops): Heads-up: Cloud marketplace checklist item: entitlement webhook + consent flow for auto-trial. We need a minimal spec so partner portals can auto-provision entitlements. Who can own the webhook and sample payload?

sam (product): I’ll own the manifest and the pricing/meter tags. Will add an `entry_points` field for entitlement hooks. ETA Tue noon.

mike (eng-api): I can build the webhook. Thinking a simple POST to /marketplace/entitlement with an HMAC header for verification. Example payload below. Will mock first.

mike (eng-api): ```json
{
  "event": "entitlement.granted",
  "sku": "redwood-core-std",
  "account": {"cloud_vendor":"aws","account_id":"123456789012"},
  "trial": {"duration_days":14},
  "signature": "hmac-sha256..."
}
```

leia (partner-ops): Perfect. Also need consent copy for EU (GDPR) shown during 1-click trial. Legal required exact text.

noah (legal): Provide this short consent snippet in manifest: "I agree to allow Redwood Inference to process inference data for the purpose of providing the trial. See privacy policy: https://privacy.redwood.ai". Make it optional checkbox visible to EU users only.

sam (product): Noted. I’ll add `consent_text` + `consent_region = ["EU"]` to the manifest. Also, pricing note: per-token meter + fallback monthly seat. Will publish meter names for each cloud (AWS: RedToken, GCP: redwood_tokens).

mike (eng-api): For auth: HMAC using a portal-provided secret, header `X-RW-Signature`. I’ll add a small verifier middleware. Anyone object?

tina (cloud-int): No objections. One region nuance: for EU regulated customers we want to recommend KMS with HSM. For the marketplace listing we should surface a KMS option in the docs but not block listing. Add `kms_recommendation` in manifest.

leia (partner-ops): Timeline/owners:
- Manifest + consent text -> sam by Tue noon
- Webhook endpoint + test harness -> mike by Wed EOD
- AWS role + entitlement mapping -> leia (me) by Wed EOD
- GCP / Azure identity templates -> tina by Wed EOD
- Legal final signoff -> noah within 24h of manifest upload

marketplace-bot: FYI: Azure Partner Center can take 48-72 hours to validate offers; include contact info in the submission to speed review. AWS seller verification + bank info must be completed to enable paid listing.

noah (legal): One more ask: include a short privacy pointer in the storefront copy (1-liner) and a link to the full DPA. I’ll prepare a DPA template snippet you can include.

sam (product): Draft manifest excerpt (WIP):
```json
{
  "sku_id": "redwood-core-std",
  "tiers": ["trial","standard","enterprise"],
  "consent_text": "I agree to allow Redwood Inference to process inference data for the purpose of providing the trial. See privacy policy: https://privacy.redwood.ai",
  "consent_region": ["EU"],
  "entitlement_webhook": "https://api.redwood.ai/marketplace/entitlement",
  "meter_tags": {"aws":"RedToken","gcp":"redwood_tokens","azure":"red_tokens"}
}
```

mike (eng-api): I'll post a sample HMAC test payload to the shared drive and a tiny docker container to exercise the endpoint. Will include a local secret env var and sample curl command.

leia (partner-ops): Logo assets: need SVG + 2x PNG (square + landscape). Marketing wants a 70-word blurb for each storefront; can product draft that too?

sam (product): Yep, will author a short blurb and a 280-char summary for the storefronts.

tina (cloud-int): Quick note on deployment manifests: GCP test deployment needs a service account with `roles/compute.admin` + `roles/secretmanager.secretAccessor`. Azure needs a managed identity + role assignment doc. I’ll attach templates.

noah (legal): Once manifest and blurb are in, I’ll supply the EULA paragraph and consent redlines. Expect within 24 hours.

leia (partner-ops): Great. Final question: do we want the entitlement webhook to immediately trigger onboarding (create account) or just record entitlement and wait for customer first use? Auto-onboard is nicer UX but increases provisioning risk. Thoughts?

sam (product): Let's do deferred provisioning: record entitlement, send welcome email, onboard on first API call. Less blast radius and easier rollback.

mike (eng-api): Agreed. Webhook will return 202 accepted and we'll enqueue an onboarding job.

leia (partner-ops): OK set. I'll update the checklist and create PR to the partnership drive when sam uploads manifest. Will tag everyone. :rocket:

marketplace-bot: Tip: attach screenshots of the in-console consent checkbox in Azure + AWS screenshots to avoid quibbles during listing review.

leia (partner-ops): Will do. Sync check-in Thurs 09:00. Anyone blocked before then ping in this thread. :thumbsup:
